metaTitle: How to Use Water Purification Tablets
description: Dose, wait and treat water correctly with chlorine dioxide, chlorine or iodine tablets, including cold and cloudy water adjustments and storage.
directAnswer: Strain the water, add the labeled dose, wait the full contact time, about 30 minutes for most chlorine dioxide products and longer when cold, cloudy or for Cryptosporidium, and wet the cap threads.
